QuestInfo.name: Yun's Worry
QuestInfo.0: Yun of the Secret Garden has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: Yun is worried that Lady Syl is in a bad mood. Go talk to Lady Syl and see if you can help.
QuestInfo.2: Lady Syl did seem to cheer up a little. It seems she lost a small portion of her memory in the trauma of losing her father. Tragic indeed.
